gate_criteria_verification.criterion: G08: Live game moves serialize transactionally, survive process restarts and socket reconnections; timers enforce persisted deadlines without loss.
gate_criteria_verification.move_transaction_serialization: Existing move rules validated; operation deduplicated before stale-revision checks; state locked, compared and committed atomically with outcome and outbox in PostgreSQL; lost-response retries return prior ack; altered-payload reuses conflict and roll back completely
gate_criteria_verification.survive_process_restarts: Active matches are never voided on boot; committed matches survive Core shutdown and are loaded with status PLAYING and identical revision/deadline/escrow; surviving Core resumes games after process kills before or after commit
gate_criteria_verification.survive_socket_reconnections: Client reconnects, redeems fresh one-use ticket, and resumes from last acknowledged revision, receiving bounded deltas or full snapshot without reapplying moves; slow clients are disconnected cleanly with 1008 and recover on reconnect
gate_criteria_verification.timers_enforce_persisted_deadlines: Deadlines are persisted as absolute timestamps in PostgreSQL; reconnect/restart never grants fresh turn duration; revision-bound keys (timeout:<matchId>:<revision>) serialize move-vs-timeout races; old timer claims cannot settle newer revisions; due timeouts settle under authority
